// --- Timer lifecycle: start the periodic end-of-period task --- semaphore.startTimer();
// Reaffirm the no-limit setting after timer has started semaphore.setLimit((-3414));

// --- Acquire operations: both succeed because negative limit means no blocking --- semaphore.tryAcquire(); semaphore.acquire();

// Retrieve the current-period acquire count twice to confirm it is stable between reads semaphore.getAcquireCount(); semaphore.getAcquireCount();
